```{r setup-metrics, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(scales)
source("src/etl/instruction_aggregate.R")

fmt_n <- function(x) if (is.na(x) || length(x) == 0) "—" else comma(x)

# --- Workshop / instruction attendance: same source + functions as instruction.qmd ---
raw_workshop_path <- "data/raw/instruction/dsc_workshops.csv"
instruction_attendance <- tryCatch({
  ucla_workshops <- load_instruction_attendee_data(raw_workshop_path)
  load_instruction_attendance(ucla_workshops)
}, error = function(e) tibble())

if (nrow(instruction_attendance) > 0) {
  m_workshop_total <- sum(instruction_attendance$attendance_count, na.rm = TRUE)
  m_workshop_ucla   <- sum(instruction_attendance$attendance_count[
    instruction_attendance$institution == "UCLA"], na.rm = TRUE)
  m_workshop_by_year <- instruction_attendance |>
    filter(!is.na(date)) |>
    mutate(Year = year(date)) |>
    summarise(n = sum(attendance_count), .by = Year) |>
    arrange(Year)
  m_workshop_depts <- instruction_attendance |>
    filter(institution == "UCLA", !is.na(standardized_department)) |>
    distinct(standardized_department) |>
    nrow()
} else {
  m_workshop_total <- m_workshop_ucla <- m_workshop_depts <- NA_integer_
  m_workshop_by_year <- tibble(Year = integer(), n = integer())
}

# --- Dataverse dataset count: query the live public search API directly. ---
# Earlier approach (API-tracked "published" count + a hand-derived "legacy
# SSDA" constant) risked double-counting, since it's unclear whether the two
# scopes overlap. Querying Dataverse's own search API for its own total
# sidesteps that: this is the same number the search UI shows, covering all
# 98+ sub-dataverses (SSDA, DIG Dataverse, Cotsen, Carceral Ecologies,
# Williams Institute, etc.) with no manual addition or subtraction.
m_dv_released_total <- tryCatch({
  resp <- jsonlite::fromJSON("https://dataverse.ucla.edu/api/search?q=*&type=dataset&per_page=1")
  resp$data$total_count
}, error = function(e) NA_integer_)

# --- Downloads: cached ETL output infrastructure.qmd reads (Dataverse's own
# metrics API has no simpler live equivalent for cumulative downloads). ---
dv_path <- "data/raw/infrastructure/datasets_files_published_monthly.csv"
dv_latest <- tryCatch({
  read_csv(dv_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    mutate(date = ym(date)) |>
    arrange(date) |>
    slice_tail(n = 1)
}, error = function(e) tibble())

if (nrow(dv_latest) > 0) {
  m_dv_downloads <- dv_latest$downloads[1]
  m_dv_asof      <- format(dv_latest$date[1], "%B %Y")
} else {
  m_dv_downloads <- NA_integer_
  m_dv_asof <- "—"
}

# --- Consultations: same audit file consulting.qmd reads ---
consult_path <- "data/processed/consultations/consultation_audit_2023_2025_summary_tagged.csv"
m_consult_total <- tryCatch({
  cs <- read_csv(consult_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  hit <- cs |> filter(str_detect(str_to_lower(metric), "direct consultations"))
  if (nrow(hit) > 0) as.numeric(hit$value[1]) else NA_integer_
}, error = function(e) NA_integer_)
```
